a: Store passwords with slow hashes like Argon2 or bcrypt, never plain text.
Regenerate session ids after login to prevent session fixation.
X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors help block clickjacking.
SSRF tricks a server into requesting internal resources.
Path traversal uses ../ to escape intended directories.
Never pass unsanitized input into shell commands.
Scan repos for accidentally committed secrets.
Pin dependency versions and review updates.
App DB users should only have needed table permissions.
HSTS tells browsers to always use HTTPS for a site.
